title: Case VIII (Serial 0576.00): Domed Disc Illustration with Dimensions, July 31, 1948
description: Shaded side-view illustration of a flat disc with a central dome. Dimension lines give a width of "20'" and a height of "6' to 8'", with the note "(Ratio approx. 3:1)" and a callout "Noted shadow". The text describes an electrician's 10-second sighting at 0825 hours of an object flying straight and level from horizon to horizon, west to east (page 84).
